blurb: Guests visit a small rural zoo with more than 180 animals including mammals, birds, reptiles, and amphibians. The zoo offers guided educational tours tailored to group age and interests, focusing on animal adaptations, habitats, conservation, and care. Additional experiences include birthday party packages, group visits, and yearly events such as Brew at the Zoo and Boo at the Zoo.
